name: Franz Delitzsch
bio:
German Lutheran scholar of the Old Testament and of Hebrew, born at Leipzig, who taught at Rostock, Erlangen and Leipzig, where he founded an institute for the study of Judaism.

With C. F. Keil he wrote the Biblical Commentary on the Old Testament, taking the Psalms, Job, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, the Song of Songs and Isaiah himself; he also wrote on Genesis and Hebrews and translated the New Testament into Hebrew.
